question: requests and bytes that reach the origin, counted by a proxy, beside the requests and bytes the browser reports, on the repeat-navigation site list
instrument: a counting HTTP proxy between Chromium and the origin (scripts/measure/wire-proxy.ts, a throwaway CA decrypts CONNECT tunnels); the browser side is Chrome DevTools Protocol Network events

method.views per site: cold home, up to 6 internal links, home repeat
method.network: the local network through the proxy, no emulation
method.wire counts: requests the proxy sent to origins, over the same navigations the browser counted; sizes are HTTP/1.1 text sizes (request line, headers, body)
method.origin leg: HTTP/1.1 only, Node TLS client; sites that vary by protocol or client can answer differently than they do to a direct browser

exclusions: a navigation whose ok field is not true did not finish loading
